why: Every route the Go API tier answers, which is every route the proxy may send it. It mirrors the `served` list in soloclef_api/cmd/api/main.go — the one place that already has to be exhaustive, because the rate limiter, the analytics hook and the body reader are all built from it. The check runs one way: a full run fails and names any route listed here that no case asked, so a case file cannot quietly stop covering a route. The other direction is a habit rather than a check — a route added to `served` and not added here is a route this suite does not know about, which is why handing one over means adding it in both places.
